mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, we are looking at clear skies and 73 degrees down at Verona Community Park, with a lovely waning crescent moon visible tonight.

The City of Verona has officially adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan. This new long-term roadmap focuses on creating stronger neighborhoods, supporting our local manufacturing and technology hubs, and ensuring a sustainable future for our downtown area.

It is a busy day in Verona today. You can enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, head to Hometown Junction Park for the Downtown Farmer's Market, grab a bite at the Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher event at the Wisconsin Brewing Company, or participate in Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory.

In a noteworthy call for service, on October 3, Verona Police officers assisted the Cottage Grove Police Department in locating an offender in a stolen firearm case, resulting in an arrest on multiple charges.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Turtle Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently open, so stop by anytime before we close our doors at 10:00 PM.
